user.title: FMI integration
user.description:
Choose the language FMI uses. It affects the query and parameter names shown when adding sensors, the language of the data FMI returns, and the language of warning texts.

Once this is set up, add sensors and warnings places from the integration page.

reconfigure.title: FMI integration
reconfigure.description: The language for sensors and warnings places added from now on. Existing ones keep their language.

init.title: Stale data
init.description:
When a sensor's newest data is older than this, its stale data sensor turns on, and a repair issue can tell you what is wrong.

The setting applies to every sensor. Daily, monthly and yearly statistics are only reported once the period is over, so for those the limit is never shorter than three days, two months or two years.

data.no_data_issue: Raise a repair issue when a sensor stops getting data
data.no_data_issue_hours: Hours without data before the data counts as stale

error.connection_problem: FMI returned no data for this query, station and parameter. Check the location and try again.

abort.already_configured: A sensor for this query, station and parameter already exists

user.title: Query
user.description: Choose what you want to measure. The list contains every observation and forecast query FMI publishes.

location.title: Location
location.description:
Pick the station to read from. Stations are ordered by distance from your Home Assistant location.

For observation queries only the stations that serve the query you chose are listed. Forecast queries are not tied to a station, so every station is offered.

You can also type a place name, or coordinates as latitude,longitude.

params.title: Parameter
params.description:
Pick the value to read. Only the parameters this station actually reports are listed, with their descriptions and units.

If the one you want is missing you can type its name. The raw query results are at {url}.

data.forecast_step: Time step between two forecast values in minutes
data.negative_as_zero: Report -1 as 0. Helpful with parameters that return -1 when there is no measurable value, such as precipitation on days when it has not rained.

name.title: Name
name.description: The suggested name comes from the station and parameter you chose.

reconfigure.title: Query
reconfigure.description: Point this sensor at a different query, station or parameter. The sensor keeps its history, so this is how to repair one whose station or parameter has stopped working.

user.title: Weather warnings
user.description:
Pick the place on the map. A warning is included when its area covers the place, or comes within the circle's radius.

On an island or by the shore, a radius of a kilometre or two makes sure the warnings for the nearby sea area are included.

no_data.title: FMI sensor {label} no longer gets data
no_data.description:
The query {query_id} returns nothing at all for {target_type} {target}.

The station may have been decommissioned or renumbered, or it may not serve this query. Check the station in FMI's observation download service and reconfigure the sensor with a working identifier.
